intent: A near-bare barbarian in smoke-cured hide and rawhide — a grey wolf-fur pauldron, a bone jaw mask with two horns and bold ash war-paint bands — so it reads from the high camera as a dark, striped, unplated fighter apart from the iron, leather, studded, linen and fenscale families.
requests: A war-paint colour with real hue (muted ochre or woad blue): the trim limits cap it at a pale ash grey.
A fur or tuft builder in Kit: the wolf pelt is stacked boxes, since every tuft would cost a part.
